title: Rotate Array
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, rotate the array to the right by `k` steps, where `k` is non-negative.

Modify `nums` in-place with `O(1)` extra space. Note that `k` may be larger than `nums.length`.
hints: Rotating by nums.length returns the array to its original order, so first reduce k to k % nums.length.
Think about what reversing the entire array does: the last k elements move to the front, and the first n - k elements move to the back — just in reversed order.
Reverse the entire array, then reverse the first k elements, and finally reverse the remaining n - k elements.

examples.explanation: Rotating right by 3 moves [5, 6, 7] to the front: [5, 6, 7, 1, 2, 3, 4].
Rotating right by 2 moves [3, 99] to the front: [3, 99, -1, -100].
Since k = 4 and length = 3, effective rotation is 4 % 3 = 1 step right: [3, 1, 2].
